one_line: Shared inbox and customer communication platform for support teams, with a Core API giving comprehensive control over contacts, conversations, and messages.
auth_notes: Front supports OAuth2.0 as well as API tokens (personal/bot API keys). Requires registering an app or generating a token in the Front admin under the company's paid account.
self_serve_notes: No free tier; needs a paid Front subscription (or trial) to generate an API token or register an OAuth app. No enterprise sales gate for the API itself.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Core API covering contacts, conversations, messages, inboxes, teammates, rules, events, accounts; 100+ endpoints with OpenAPI spec.
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhooks supported for events such as message inbound/outbound, conversation assignment, comments, etc.

existing_mcp.note: Front publishes an official MCP server; community wrappers also exist.

evidence.note: Fetched text (014_front.txt) confirms OAuth2 + API tokens, base URL api2.frontapp.com, JSON + multipart, rate limits. MCP/webhook details from knowledge.

agent_notes: Webhook support and MCP existence inferred from knowledge, not the fetched text.
